info.title: PIMMS Universal API
info.description: Create deep links and track conversions, analytics, and referrals

post.description: Creates a new deep link in PIMMS.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: Destination URL the deep link redirects to. Supports standard webpages and in-app routing for mobile apps.

domain.description: Custom domain for your branded deep link. Defaults to the workspace’s primary domain or 'pim.ms'.

key.description: Custom slug for the short URL. If omitted, an automatic 7-character key is generated.

externalId.description: External identifier for syncing link data with your internal CRM or analytics tools. Passed in query parameters prefixed by 'ext_'.

prefix.description: Custom URL path prefix for grouping auto-generated slugs (e.g., '/promo/' resulting in '/promo/abc123'). Ignored if 'key' is specified.

trackConversion.description: Enable detailed conversion tracking to attribute actions like signups or purchases directly to this link.

archived.description: Archive the link to hide it from primary analytics while keeping it active for redirects.

tagIds.description: List of existing tag IDs to categorize and filter links by campaigns, audiences, or purposes.

tagNames.description: New or existing tag names to assign for improved readability and organization.

comments.description: Internal notes for team members about link context, purpose, or specific campaign details.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the link should stop redirecting users.

expiredUrl.description: Fallback destination URL after link expiration, preventing broken user experiences.

title.description: Custom Open Graph (OG) title to optimize social media sharing and improve link previews.

description.description: Custom Open Graph description for better engagement when shared on social platforms.

image.description: URL for a custom OG image to enhance visual appeal and click-through rates on social media.

video.description: Custom video URL for rich media previews via Open Graph when sharing links.

ios.description: The iOS destination URL for the short link for iOS device targeting.

android.description: The Android destination URL for the short link for Android device targeting.

doIndex.description: Allow search engine indexing of the deep link. Defaults to false for privacy.

utmSource.description: UTM source parameter for tracking the origin of traffic (e.g., 'linkedin', 'facebook', 'newsletter').

utmMedium.description: UTM medium parameter identifying traffic medium such as 'post', 'email', 'social', or 'cpc'.

utmCampaign.description: UTM campaign parameter for tracking specific marketing initiatives or promotions.

utmTerm.description: UTM term parameter for keyword analysis, often used in paid search campaigns.

utmContent.description: UTM content parameter distinguishing different content variations or link placements within a campaign.

ref.description: Custom referral parameter appended as '?ref=' for downstream attribution and analysis.

webhookIds[].description: Webhook IDs to trigger real-time notifications upon link clicks, ideal for integrating with analytics or marketing automation tools.

android.description: The Android destination URL for the short link for Android device targeting.

archived.description: Determines if the link is archived, thus excluded from standard analytics views.

clicks.description: Total click count tracking user engagements.

comments.description: Internal team notes describing the context, strategy, or use of the link.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the link was first created.

description.description: OG description for enhanced social previews, either automatically fetched or manually customized.

domain.description: Domain used for the deep link, e.g., 'yourbrand.com' or 'pim.ms'.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format; after this, the link redirects to an expired URL or returns a 404.

id.description: Unique internal identifier for the deep link.

image.description: URL to the OG image displayed in social previews, improving shareability.

ios.description: The iOS destination URL for the short link for iOS device targeting.

key.description: Short URL slug appended after the domain, uniquely identifying the link.

lastClicked.description: Timestamp of the most recent click event.

leads.description: Total conversions attributed directly to this link.

qrCode.description: Direct link to the dynamically generated QR code for offline or print campaigns.

shortLink.description: Fully constructed deep link URL including domain and protocol.

tags.description: Associated tags for organizing links by campaigns, audiences, or other criteria.

title.description: OG title for optimized social media link previews, fetched or set manually.

trackConversion.description: Indicates whether this link actively tracks conversion events like leads or sales.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the link was last modified.

url.description: Complete original destination URL or mobile app route to which the link redirects users.

userId.description: Identifier of the user who created the link.

utm_campaign.description: Assigned UTM campaign for detailed campaign-level tracking.

utm_content.description: Assigned UTM content for distinguishing content variations within the same campaign.

utm_medium.description: Assigned UTM medium for categorizing the traffic source.

utm_source.description: Assigned UTM source parameter for tracking marketing origins.

utm_term.description: Assigned UTM term parameter used for keyword or search tracking.

video.description: Optional video URL used in rich media previews via Open Graph.

webhookIds.description: Webhooks triggered on each click event for real-time tracking and integration purposes.

workspaceId.description: Identifier of the workspace that the link belongs to.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves filtered analytics metrics from PIMMS.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The type of event to retrieve analytics for. Defaults to `clicks`.

schema.description: The type of event to retrieve analytics for. Defaults to `clicks`.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: The parameter to group the analytics data points by. Defaults to `count` if undefined.

schema.description: The parameter to group the analytics data points by. Defaults to `count` if undefined.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain to filter analytics for.

schema.description: The domain to filter analytics for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The short link slug.

schema.description: The short link slug.

parameters.name: linkId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the short link on PiMMs.

schema.description: The unique ID of the short link on PiMMs.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: This is the ID of the link in the your database. Must be prefixed with 'ext_' when passed as a query parameter.

schema.description: This is the ID of the link in the your database. Must be prefixed with 'ext_' when passed as a query parameter.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant that created the link inside your system.

schema.description: The ID of the tenant that created the link inside your system.

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: The ID of the program to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The ID of the program to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: partnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the partner to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The ID of the partner to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: The interval to retrieve analytics for. If undefined, defaults to 24h.

schema.description: The interval to retrieve analytics for. If undefined, defaults to 24h.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start date and time when to retrieve analytics from. Takes precedence over `interval`.

schema.description: The start date and time when to retrieve analytics from. Takes precedence over `interval`.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end date and time when to retrieve analytics from. If not provided, defaults to the current date. Takes precedence over `interval`.

schema.description: The end date and time when to retrieve analytics from. If not provided, defaults to the current date. Takes precedence over `interval`.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: The IANA time zone code for aligning timeseries granularity (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.

schema.description: The IANA time zone code for aligning timeseries granularity (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The country to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The city to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The ISO 3166-2 region code to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The ISO 3166-2 region code to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: continent
parameters.description: The continent to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The continent to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The device to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The device to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: browser
parameters.description: The browser to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The browser to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: The OS to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The OS to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The trigger to retrieve analytics for. If undefined, return both QR and link clicks.

schema.description: The trigger to retrieve analytics for. If undefined, return both QR and link clicks.

parameters.name: referer
parameters.description: The referer to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The referer to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: refererUrl
parameters.description: The full referer URL to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The full referer URL to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The URL to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Deprecated. Use `tagIds` instead. The tag ID to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: Deprecated. Use `tagIds` instead. The tag ID to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: tagIds
parameters.description: The tag IDs to retrieve analytics for.

schema.description: The tag IDs to retrieve analytics for.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The folder ID to retrieve analytics for. If not provided, return analytics for unsorted links.

schema.description: The folder ID to retrieve analytics for. If not provided, return analytics for unsorted links.

parameters.name: qr
parameters.description: Deprecated. Use the `trigger` field instead. Filter for QR code scans. If true, filter for QR codes only. If false, filter for links only. If undefined, return both.

schema.description: Deprecated. Use the `trigger` field instead. Filter for QR code scans. If true, filter for QR codes only. If false, filter for links only. If undefined, return both.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Filter for root domains. If true, filter for domains only. If false, filter for links only. If undefined, return both.

schema.description: Filter for root domains. If true, filter for domains only. If false, filter for links only. If undefined, return both.

parameters.name: utmSource
parameters.description: The UTM source of the short link.

schema.description: The UTM source of the short link.

parameters.name: utmMedium
parameters.description: The UTM medium of the short link.

schema.description: The UTM medium of the short link.

parameters.description: The UTM campaign of the short link.

parameters.name: utmTerm
parameters.description: The UTM term of the short link.

schema.description: The UTM term of the short link.

parameters.name: utmContent
parameters.description: The UTM content of the short link.

schema.description: The UTM content of the short link.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

clicks.description: Total click count for the filtered analytics window.

leads.description: Total attributed lead conversions for the filtered analytics window.

saleAmount.description: Total attributed sale amount for the filtered analytics window.

sales.description: Total attributed sales conversions for the filtered analytics window.

get.description: Retrieves a QR code image from PIMMS.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to generate a QR code for.

schema.description: The URL to generate a QR code for.

parameters.name: logo
parameters.description: The logo to include in the QR code. Can only be used with a paid plan on PiMMs

schema.description: The logo to include in the QR code. Can only be used with a paid plan on PiMMs

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the QR code in pixels. Defaults to `600` if not provided.

schema.description: The size of the QR code in pixels. Defaults to `600` if not provided.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of error correction to use for the QR code. Defaults to `L` if not provided.

schema.description: The level of error correction to use for the QR code. Defaults to `L` if not provided.

parameters.name: fgColor
parameters.description: The foreground color of the QR code in hex format. Defaults to `#000000` if not provided.

schema.description: The foreground color of the QR code in hex format. Defaults to `#000000` if not provided.

parameters.name: bgColor
parameters.description: The background color of the QR code in hex format. Defaults to `#ffffff` if not provided.

schema.description: The background color of the QR code in hex format. Defaults to `#ffffff` if not provided.

parameters.name: hideLogo
parameters.description: Whether to hide the logo in the QR code. Can only be used with a paid plan on PiMMs.

schema.description: Whether to hide the logo in the QR code. Can only be used with a paid plan on PiMMs.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: The size of the margin around the QR code. Defaults to 2 if not provided.

schema.description: The size of the margin around the QR code. Defaults to 2 if not provided.

parameters.name: includeMargin
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Margin is included by default. Use the `margin` prop to customize the margin size.

schema.description: DEPRECATED: Margin is included by default. Use the `margin` prop to customize the margin size.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Raw PNG bytes surfaced as an array of numbers.

type.description: Node-style buffer discriminator returned for the raw PNG response.

post.description: Creates a new tracked lead event in PIMMS.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

clickId.description: Unique identifier for the click event in PIMMS, typically retrieved from the 'pimms_id' browser cookie for accurate attribution.

eventName.description: Name of the specific lead or conversion event you want to track (e.g., 'Sign up', 'Free Trial Registration').

externalId.description: A unique identifier from your internal system (such as user ID) to link customer journeys across platforms.

customerName.description: Optional customer name, useful for personalized reporting and CRM integrations.

customerEmail.description: Customer email address to enhance CRM synchronization and facilitate personalized marketing efforts.

customerAvatar.description: URL to the customer's avatar image, used for richer user profiles in integrated CRM or analytics platforms.

metadata.description: Additional structured data or context about the lead event, aiding advanced segmentation and reporting.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new tracked sale event in PIMMS.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

externalId.description: This is the unique identifier for the customer in the client's app. This is used to track the customer's journey.

amount.description: The amount of the sale. Should be passed in cents.

paymentProcessor.description: The payment processor via which the sale was made.

eventName.description: The name of the sale event. It can be used to track different types of event for example 'Purchase', 'Upgrade', 'Payment', etc.

invoiceId.description: The invoice ID of the sale.

currency.description: The currency of the sale. Accepts ISO 4217 currency codes.

metadata.description: Additional metadata to be stored with the sale event.
